title: CFA Institute Research Challenge Sub-regional Presentation Scoring Sheet

criteria.name: Financial Analysis
criteria.official_prompt: How thorough was their analysis of the industry, company, and competitors?

criteria.name: Valuation
criteria.official_prompt: Were the valuation methodologies appropriate and detailed?

criteria.name: Environmental, Social, and Governance
criteria.official_prompt: Did the analysis thoroughly incorporate conservation of the natural world, consideration of people and relationships, and standards for running a company?

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.official_prompt: How effective/convincing was their presentation? Was it logical and did the facts support the recommendation?

sources.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge Official Rules 2025-2026
